Author: KryptonResearch14
Text: $VRT Wells Fargo upgraded to strong-buy Thursday and set a 340 target (per Benzinga/Dow Jones). The stock added 3.2% Friday to close at 253.22. The gap worth watching: 25 of 29 analysts have it at buy or better with a consensus target around 357, yet the stock still sits about 29% below that. Last quarter shows why. EPS beat (1.52 vs 1.43 expected) but revenue missed (3.27B vs 3.38B expected). Q3 guidance is 1.77 to 1.83 EPS, so the ramp is already in the numbers. At roughly 38x forward earnings on the FY guide, the quarter has to deliver both the top line and the margin. The upgrade is a bet it does.
